checks.note: GraphQL page: personal API keys from Security & access sent as `Authorization: <API_KEY>` with no prefix; OAuth2 tokens sent as Bearer. OAuth page confirms auth-code (PKCE optional, actor user/app, 24h tokens with refresh) and client_credentials (app actor, 30-day token, must be enabled in app settings).

Vendor pages describe self-serve creation of API keys and OAuth apps and mention no app review, but neither page states plan requirements. Free-plan API access appears only in third-party blogs, not on a Linear page.

The GraphQL endpoint is https://api.linear.app/graphql and the OAuth flow calls it. Scopes cover issues, comments, customers, initiatives and more, which fits broad. I did not check a REST API and found no evidence of one.
Linear's own docs describe a centrally hosted MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp. It supports OAuth 2.1 and Bearer tokens (OAuth token or API key). The /sse endpoint is deprecated.
Auth, API and official MCP are all confirmed. The only open point is free-plan API access, which is unverified. Calling it ready is reasonable, with that caveat noted in the blocker.

corrected.one_liner: Linear is a project and issue tracking tool for software teams, with issues, projects, cycles and roadmaps.
corrected.auth_notes: Personal API keys are created in Security & access settings and sent as `Authorization: <API_KEY>` with no Bearer prefix. OAuth2 authorization-code flow (optional PKCE, actor=user or app) gives 24h access tokens with refresh tokens. OAuth2 client_credentials is also available for server-to-server use (app actor, 30-day token) once enabled on the app. OAuth access tokens are sent as Bearer.
corrected.access_notes: Personal API keys and OAuth2 apps are created self-serve in workspace settings. The OAuth page lists no app review or approval step. Linear's pages do not state plan requirements. Only third-party sources say the free plan has API access, so this is not verified from the vendor. The OAuth page recommends a dedicated workspace for app development.
corrected.blocker: none. Rate limits not reviewed; free-plan API access not verified on a Linear page.
